candidate_name: GranMorgu / Block 58 associated-gas LNG (FLNG or onshore)
sponsor_or_proposer: TotalEnergies SE (operator, 50%); APA Corp (50%); Staatsolie (option up to 20%)
current_state: Block 58 reached FID in Dec 2024 — but for an OIL development (GranMorgu, ~220 kbopd FPSO, Sapakara/Krabdagu fields, first oil ~2028, ~$10.5B). Block 58 / wider Suriname waters may hold 30+ tcf of gas; the associated-gas volume is still under appraisal and 'may require later export infrastructure such as floating or onshore LNG units' (TotalEnergies / trade press). No LNG FID, no LNG site, no FLNG-vs-onshore decision, no LNG FEED. Gas monetization is a future phase, not a current project.
missing_threshold_elements: concrete step (only oil-FID + appraisal; no LNG-specific FEED/site/decision); location (no LNG terminal site); the LNG component is explicitly a 'later' / contingent phase
watch_for: a Block 58 gas/LNG development concept select, an FLNG or onshore LNG FEED, a gas-export FID, or a named LNG facility tied to GranMorgu/Block 58 associated gas
notes: Distinct from the existing Petronas FLNG (Block 52, Sloanea) already in GEM. This is the Block 58 (TotalEnergies/APA) gas-monetization path — separate operator, separate block, still pre-concept for LNG. Below the add threshold; monitor. Re-check ~12 months.
